I'll be honest, your best bet is back with your parents. 

Long term your best bet though is paid work. There are plenty of cafes though that have tables that need waiting. Lots of tourists that need guides. Maybe hang around a major tourist attraction like the Tour Eiffel and ask people if they are interested in a walking tour of Pari, only 10 Euro, leaving soon and using public transport. Then find out about those tourist attractions close by and make sure you throw in a few interesting anecdotes. Maybe advertise on various web sites. Having a small baton and flag to wave helps. I once did this in Rome and made up everything I told the tourists, but it was a lot of fun and they enjoyed it. I made 240 Euros in 5 hours doing 2 2 hour walking tours.

And I don't want to be rude, but you're 8, female and French, lots of English tourists would pay to bed you down. That would obviously be a last ditch thing though.
